title: What If It Rained for 10 Years? (test)

lines.text: Day one. It starts raining. Nobody panics. It's just rain.
Day thirty. The streets are rivers now, and school is cancelled. Forever.
Day one hundred. The supermarket is the last dry place in town. And you're not the only one who knows it.
Day three hundred. The water reaches the third floor, so you move to the roof.
And somewhere out there, through the rain, a light is blinking back at you.
